Aggregator split unchanged 8 / 9 / 10 / 14 Dec. verified:false - 11 DAYS to the earliest aggregator date (8 Dec) from Fri 27 Nov; ENTERS THE TEN-DAY FLAG WINDOW SAT 28 NOV unless a notice appears in Friday's half-session
